name: preflight
command: set -eu; ! pgrep -x firecracker; ! pgrep -x vmshm-broker; test "$(basename "$(readlink -f /sys/bus/platform/devices/fb000000.gpu/driver)")" = pmthor; test "$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online)" = 0-1; test -z "$(losetup -a)"; echo HEALTH=PASS; uname -a; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/meminfo; dmesg
